verdict.rationale: Decagon is itself an AI agent platform (building/operating customer-support agents), and its MCP references describe consuming/exposing tools as a client to power its own agents (decagon-docs-3, decagon-docs-34), not shipping an official MCP server for external agents to connect to Decagon. Per the agent-role exception, this axis is out of scope unless Decagon documents running as an MCP server itself, which no evidence shows.
